title: Provide an option to add new connections from the applet
line: The Networks widget has an Add Connection button that opens the connection type chooser, for hidden Wi-Fi networks, VPNs and more.
explanation: The Networks widget had no way to add a connection: to join a hidden Wi-Fi network or set up a VPN you had to open the settings page and find its small add button. The widget's toolbar now has an Add Connection button (list-add, next to the QR code button) that opens System Settings with a new AddConnection argument, which makes the Wi-Fi & Networking page show its Choose a Connection Type dialog right away (also when System Settings is already open).

commits.message:
applet: add a button to add a new connection

Adding a connection, like a hidden Wi-Fi network or a VPN, meant opening
the settings page and finding its add button. The widget's toolbar now has
an Add Connection button that opens the connection type chooser directly.

BUG: 449443

media.caption: Networks widget toolbar on master: no way to add a connection
New Add Connection button at the end of the toolbar
On master the only route is the configure button, which opens the connection details page
Add Connection opens System Settings straight into Choose a Connection Type
